products.name: Credo AI
products.note: Purpose-built AI governance; policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF; clean interface; fast deployment

profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an enterprise software company focused on AI governance, offering a platform it describes as purpose-built to help organizations discover AI systems, enforce policies, manage risk, and demonstrate regulatory compliance across models, agents, and applications. The company describes itself as having created the AI governance category and says its platform is powered by a Knowledge Graph that combines global regulatory intelligence with customer business context, supported by more than 300 integrations and a team of forward-deployed governance experts. The platform includes pre-built policy packs covering the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, and the company states that members of its team participated directly in standards development at bodies including ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD.

The core product, the Credo AI platform, provides model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in a single interface, and includes GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), described as generally available and capable of compressing weeks of governance work into hours. The company describes agents as first-class governed entities within the platform, registered, risk-assessed, and subject to controls that are automatically differentiated by regulatory context and use case. Mastercard and IBM are named on the company's site as organizations using or collaborating with the platform, with IBM's collaboration specifically cited in connection with Compliance Accelerators. Fast Company ranked Credo AI No. 6 in Applied AI on its World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 list, alongside Google, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

The site's held facts note that Credo AI's platform is tracked in the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, with no litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records currently associated with the company in this dataset.
